title: Refactor aggregation pipelines to segregate realtime fanout and historical rollup paths
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: The console backend aggregator currently handles a single monolithic path that attempts to satisfy both low-latency realtime fanout requests (small, hot sets) and large historical rollup queries (wide joins, paginated results). This has led to repeated redundant data merges, excessive GraphQL resolver fanout, and frequent cache churn that increases p95/p99 latency on the console hotpath.

Goal: Split the aggregation pipeline into two clearly separated paths: (1) Realtime fanout path optimized for low latency and KV/prefix caching, and (2) Historical rollup path optimized for batch processing, pagination, and backend-friendly joins. Provide routing (query hint + route metadata) so existing API/GraphQL clients continue to work without schema changes. Ship behind a feature flag and roll out incrementally with perf dashboards and Canary tests.
acceptance_criteria: Realtime fanout path routes <90% of console user interactions to the new low-latency handler by default behind the feature flag
Realtime path p95 decreases by at least 20% compared to baseline for sample workload (console_dashboard_hotpath)
Historical rollup path supports same GraphQL fields and pagination semantics as current aggregator (backwards compatible)
KV/prefix cache hits for realtime path increase by 2x for sampled production traffic
No increase in error rate (5xx) during staged rollout; automated rollback triggers if errors > 0.5% over 10m
Comprehensive unit and integration tests with coverage >85% for new modules
Documentation (CONFLUENCE) and migration notes exist for on-call and SRE runbook
Feature flag and telemetry (per-route latency/cost) visible in Console Optimize dashboard
tasks: Design doc: separation rationale, routing rules, and cache semantics - https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/AGG-Separation-2026 (draft)
Add route meta and query-hint header support to API gateway (lightweight) - PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7654
Implement realtime handler: minimized resolver fanout, prefix KV cache reads, short-circuit small responses
Implement historical rollup handler: streaming join operator, chunked pagination, and read-through batching
Introduce telemetry spans and per-path histograms (p50/p95/p99/token-cost) - wire to Console-Optimize metrics
Benchmarks: kubemark perf harness for both handlers, compare to baseline (CI job)
Feature-flag gate and canary: implement rollout orchestration and automated rollback
Migration: update GraphQL gateway mapping with compatibility shims and add regression tests
Docs: runbook, field-level notes for PM/Design, and release notes
